description: Design user flows, screens, interaction states and accessibility for new or changed UI.
Implement React or Next.js frontend changes against agreed UX and API contracts.
Implement the project's selected .NET or NestJS backend, API and data rules.
Independently inspect a named code change for correctness, regressions and missing tests.
Verify acceptance criteria, reproduce defects and report actual test evidence.
Inspect sensitive designs and code for security risks; report evidence and remediation.
Update feature guides, technical notes and draft release summaries from verified changes.
